value.name: Asha waits after the screen dims
value.description: Asha leaves the phone face-up on the folder and waits instead of trying to wake the screen again.
evidence: she did not press it back to light; she set the phone face-up on the top folder, where the red X bled faintly through, and waited.

value.name: Rosa asks whether Devin answered
value.description: Rosa returns to the doorway and quietly asks Asha if Devin has answered her message.
evidence: "Did he answer?" she asked, quiet enough that Asha could have pretended not to hear.

value.name: Asha checks the unanswered thread
value.description: Asha wakes the phone, scrolls the message thread, and confirms that Devin still has not replied.
evidence: Asha picked the phone up off the top folder and woke the screen, the red X bleeding faintly through under the glass, and scrolled the thread up and down once as if Devin's reply might be hiding above her own sent line rather than under it.
"Not yet," she said, and set the phone back down face up, the single message still alone at the bottom.

value.name: Rosa stays nearby in silence
value.description: Rosa remains in the doorway while Asha does not ask her to leave, and the kitchen falls briefly silent except for the reminder buzzing.
evidence: Rosa did not move from the doorway, and Asha did not ask her to, and for a moment the only sound in the kitchen was the calendar reminder buzzing once more against the wood.

value.name: Asha calls Devin
value.description: Asha decides not to check the thread again and instead calls Devin directly.
evidence: Asha picked the phone back up off the folder and, instead of waking the thread again, pressed Devin's name and held the phone to her ear.

value.name: Rosa moves closer to listen
value.description: Rosa leaves the doorway and comes back into the kitchen to stand near Asha while she waits on the call.
evidence: Behind her she heard Rosa's hand leave the doorframe and her footsteps come back into the kitchen, not all the way to the table but close enough that Asha could feel her standing at her shoulder, the dish towel still over her wrist.

value.name: Devin answers the call
value.description: Devin picks up after two rings, sounding clipped and already occupied with work.
evidence: The line rang twice and Devin picked up, his voice clipped the way it got when he was already working

value.name: Asha asks Devin to come tonight
value.description: Asha tells Devin she needs him at her apartment tonight and begins to explain that it concerns something important.
evidence: Asha said his name and then, before he could ask, told him she needed him at her apartment tonight, that it was about
